notes.title: [0.5.5] Update
notes.content:
Now you can customize keyboard controls. Except you can't change actions of default keys, only add additional ones. Both sets would work at the same time and you don't have to bind every additional action.

Display area got reworked, so now game field is more zoomed-in by default on most screen resolutions(1366x768, 1280x1024, etc.).

You can also control zoom on controller using LB и RT buttons.

notes.title: Rainy City: Part 2
notes.content:
[h1]A campaign was added to the game, so now at last you can have a walk-through![/h1]
Also:
[list][*]Achievements
[*]5 more locations
[*]Hero perks
[/list]

Now be quick or be DED!

Less significant updates are posted in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507403161003678/]this[/url] thread.

notes.title: «Double-barreled shotgun» challenge.
notes.content:
Second marathon awaits our heroic DED. Now he got a hold of his favorite old trusty double-barreled shotgun. Less distance and ammo but look at that damage!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/571350/announcements/detail/677065258246890598]Prizes are the same for most hardcore players - free keys for upcoming DLC.[/url]

But there's a slight pleasant change in the rules - now you can be eligible to win even if someone else has reached that wave before you, because now everyone has unique UserID and therefore verification code.

So for example, if max wave reached is 42, then three players to reach it first win.

Good luck and git gud!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507548120630259/]«Double-barreled Shotgun» challenge. Kill count.[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507548120635986/]«Double-barreled Shotgun» challenge. Wave records.[/url]

[h1]Winners:[/h1] 
[b]Kill count:[/b] Lord - 1548

[b]Wave records:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Lord - 34
[*]MrBrankoW - 22
[*]Nemurenai - 12
[/list]
[h1]Congratulations![/h1]
